description.zh: 最大结果集。建议取值在1~100之间。
description.en: The maximum number of results to return. The recommended value is from 1 to 100.

description.zh: 用来标记当前查询结束的位置，以便下一次调用时作为参数传入，继续翻页。首次调用或返回最后一页时，取值为空字符串。
description.en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. If this is your first query, leave this parameter empty.
The ID of the resource group that contains the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open list-instances --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 1 --resource-group-id rg-aekzu74zjgdu4mq --region cn-hangzhou
